input: Audience: library visitors. Question: “May I bring a drink into the reading room?” Approved fact and policy: water in a closed bottle is allowed in the reading room. Exception: other drinks are not allowed. Prohibited promise: do not promise storage for excluded drinks. Unknown cases go to the Service Desk using “Ask the Service Desk about uncovered cases.”

entries.question: May I bring a drink into the reading room?
entries.direct_response: Water in a closed bottle is allowed; other drinks are not allowed.
supported_detail: The permission applies in the reading room only.
exceptions: Drinks other than water in a closed bottle are excluded.
unknown_cases: Drink situations not covered by the supplied rules remain unknown.
entries.escalation: Ask the Service Desk about uncovered cases.
